description: A box with visibility hidden keeps its space and draws nothing; a descendant that is visible again still draws

florui.css: .wrap { width: 120px; padding: 10px; background-color: #223; } .a, .b, .c { width: 100px; height: 30px; background-color: #556; border: 3px solid #fff; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #e85; } .c { background-color: #4c8; } .b { visibility: hidden; background-color: #e33; } .shown { visibility: visible; width: 40px; height: 12px; background-color: #48c; } .inherits { width: 40px; height: 12px; background-color: #fc0; }
